name: Alison: Fall of the Apple
source:
In Alison Fall of the Apple, you play as Michael (default name). Michael is a highly trained military veteran who has been working as a police officer in NYC since the disappearance of his pregnant wife a few years ago. While on patrol, MC saves the life of a young woman named Alison. After rescuing Alison, your life is thrown into chaos with thugs, hitmen, and the corrupt elite of the Big Apple trying to hunt you both down. With lives on the line, choices will matter and decisions will have major consequences, for you and those around you. Help Alice escape her fate and perhaps even uncover the truth behind the disappearance of your wife.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800530/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《艾莉森：苹果的陨落》中，你扮演迈克尔（默认名）。迈克尔是一名训练有素的军人，自怀孕的妻子数年前失踪后，一直在纽约担任警察。巡逻时，主人公救下了名叫艾莉森的年轻女性。救出艾莉森后，你们的生活陷入混乱：暴徒、杀手与大苹果城腐败的精英都试图追捕你们。

性命危在旦夕，选择将产生影响，决定会给你和身边的人带来重大后果。帮助艾莉逃离命运，或许还能揭开妻子失踪的真相。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800530/]Steam[/url]]
